input: work/standalone/tools/sdlfeed.c (DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES into the ad-hoc-signed Homebrew binary): SDL key events synthesized inside the process on presented frames, from the retro-run script mapped to Mednafen's default keys (gen_sdlfeed.py); F9 snapshot for shot, F10 reset, F12 exit (Mednafen writes saves on exit)

layout.name: <ROM file name without extension>.<game MD5 as Mednafen computes it>.<ext> (filesys.fname_sav %f.%M%x)

note: Needs a user-made override file: without it Mednafen 1.32 picks 64 KiB flash for Emerald, writes a 65536-byte .sav, logs 'SRAM emulation disabled by write to 0e005555' and the game hangs on a white screen at the save (first run, not filed). With sav/<name>.<md5>.type containing 'flash 128' and 'rtc' (made by hand before the run, not filed) the save works: 131072 bytes, and no clock data in the file (Mednafen GBA reads the host clock). beetle-gba gets 128 KiB without any override file.
